spans.text: On an aircraft headed to the former address of Zeratul-Worcester Pharmaceuticals.
Squad 404 is reading through the data provided by the Commander.
So this pharma company paid several years' worth of expenses up front, but it's been abandoned for a few months now...
And recently, they've picked up a signal from an unknown server...
Sounds like an urban legend to me.
Are all these technical jargons actual words? This is way too hard for me to understand...
The company is mainly concerned with biomedicine, the development of biotechnological materials, and...
There's a surprising amount of info about it, but it just looks like an ordinary corporation.
What does the Commander want us to dig up?
Well, we're getting a pretty penny for this job, so we'll have a hard time explaining ourselves if we don't find something valuable.
As for the Commander's request...
"In order to rebuild Griffin, we request that you make this mission your top priority."
"We've sent you detailed files on the pharmaceutical company. It seems to be partnered with William, but we don't know what kind of cooperation they're engaged in."
"If you can find something, it might be able to help Ange."
"Take Squad 404 and check it out."
416 follows the voice and pulls Anna out of a supply crate.
When did this brat sneak onboard?
I-I'll never tell you!
It probably involved a lot of acting cute around Kalina.
Anna, why are you following us?
I know that drug plant you're investigating has something to do with Paradeus!
I also want to know what they did to me and what that medicine I took every day really was...
You could've just waited until we came back to make our report.
Yeah... Why waste energy running around outside when you can sleep at the base...
Humph, you grown-ups are all so sneaky! There's no way I'd believe the lies you tell to trick kids!
I'm going to investigate on my own and witness the truth with my own eyes!
...You're pretty smart.
Tsk, another millstone around my neck.
Anyway, I'm here, so it's too late to turn back now!
Oh, there are MANY ways to deal with deadweight.
For instance, we could turn around and head back to base. Or...
We could just toss you off the plane right now.
Y-You're just trying to scare me, right?
UMP45 unfastens her seat belt, then she picks up Anna with a smile and heads over to the cabin hatch. UMP9 plays along with perfect coordination and makes to open it.
Bye, Anna. See you back at the base!
Nooooooo!!!!!
Big Sis 416! Big Sis Gr G11! Help meeeee!
Zzz...
(Whimpers) Wait!
I-I can be useful too!
Sometimes, I get flashes of memories in my head...
They're very familiar, but they don't seem like they belong to me...
And recently, I saw a building that looks a lot like the drug plant!
Now that's a very compelling reason to keep you around.
I mean, the place you're investigating has something to do with Nytos, right?
I'm sure I can help! And I promise I'll be good and listen to you!
UMP45 puts Anna down.
Let me make this clear, I'm limited to one piece of carry-on luggage.
Well, we promised Ange we'd take care of this brat. If anything happens to her, we don't get paid.
So you know which piece of luggage you should be discarding, right?
Gr G11 starts wide awake as she hears that keyword.
No... No way!!!
Hahaha...
Laughter fills the aircraft's cabin.
Several hours later.
At the former address of Z-W Pharma.
So we flew for several hours to investigate this building which could collapse into rubble at any moment?
Stay alert. We need to find the necessary info before we get crushed inside.
It's so spooky... Like the haunted house in the TV series I was binging last week...
I've got a bad feeling about this too...
You know, if the two of you are scared, why not wait at the entr—
Huh? Was that a Sangvis Dinergate that just ran past the door?
Before she can finish, a trembling Gr G11 has already climbed onto 416's back, and Anna is clinging to her coat.
What is it? Where?!
W-Why did you scare us all of a sudden?!
Hey! This isn't like what we agreed on, is it?!
But I wasn't scaring you...
Let's go, 9.
We'll take point and give 416 more space.
Sure thing, 45!
UMP9 understands UMP45's eye signal and immediately runs up after her.
Hey—
Squad 404 enters Z-W Pharmaceuticals.
Behind a dusty window, a mysterious figure darts past.
Those Griffin pests are here too?!
I need to tell her ASAP so we can come up with a plan...
